title: Most of PH to have fair weather; expect rain in parts of Luzon, Mindanao

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Most parts of the country are expected to experience generally fair weather, while parts of Luzon and Mindanao may see cloudy skies and rain due to the effects of the shear line and easterlies, the state weather bureau said. According to the latest weather forecast issued by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the shear line will mostly affect Extreme Northern Luzon, particularly Batanes and the Babuyan Islands, on Friday.
